description.narrative: Sonar Music SA - Partner project, aims to equip, empower, and mobilize young people to be agents of change in their communities through the medium of music. South Africa has the highest youth unemployment rate in the world and a very racially divided history with education being a major area of division. As a result, the youth of South Africa still face this great divide between the quality of education which leads to overwhelming hopelessness. The project will use the focus on music to equip young people with: Quality education, skill development, and leadership training. We believe that this will empower the target group with: Hope for a better future, leadership authority, knowledge that inspires change, a belief that they can achieve great outcomes and lead change in their community. Training workshops, Music courses, Music events, Cultural exchange trips, Leadership courses and weekly member activities for developing a supporting environment for growth.
